issues.description: Person REST endpoint path is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement specifies CRUD under "/persons" (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /persons...), the solution client sends requests to "persons" (e.g., .uri("persons")), but the solution server exposes the endpoints under "people" (e.g., @GetMapping("people"), @PostMapping("people"), ...). This mismatch breaks client-server interaction and confuses students about the required API routes.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the server to the specified and client-used routes by changing PersonResource mappings from "people" to "persons" (i.e., @GetMapping("persons"), @PostMapping("persons"), @PutMapping("persons/{personId}"), @DeleteMapping("persons/{personId}")). Alternatively, if "people" is intended, update the problem statement and both template/solution clients to use "people" consistently.
